method: Diagnostic CPU traces of source dd9a3d01: 3 held relative release trials per build profile, 1 s before release through native handoff. Dev and release use identical production sources (archive byte comparison passed). Profiles differ; these are not a like-for-like code-only speedup claim or a formal 20-trial gate.
finding: The original CPU tail was dominated by cold reveal-edge geometry and composition, with small text-shaping time. CPU rendering excludes GL context creation as its cause.
